moves.name: Fairy Wish
moves.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Fairy Zone. (A Fairy Zone powers up Fairy-type attacks.)

moves.name: Wild Electroweb
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When weather, terrain, or zone effects are activated.
Deactivation Condition: When all weather, terrain, and zone effects are cleared.

This attack’s power is doubled when the zone is a Fairy Zone. Lowers the target’s Speed by 2 stat ranks. Raises the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks.

moves.name: Maximum Power!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 2 stat ranks. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 when the zone is a Fairy Zone.

moves.name: Thundering Deity Gigavolt Havoc
moves.description: This attack’s power increases when the terrain is Electric Terrain.

passives.name: Guardian Deity of Conflict
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when the zone is a Fairy Zone. Turns the field of play’s terrain into Electric Terrain the first time the user uses Fairy Wish each battle. Extends the duration of the Fairy Zone when the zone turns into a Fairy Zone while the user is on the field.

subPassives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when the zone is a Fairy Zone.

subPassives.name: Fairy Zone Extension 3

passives.name: Electric Terrain Debut & Extension 5
